sentences.text:
Bench: D.Ramesh
 Hon'Ble Sri Justice D.Ramesh
 Criminal Petition No. 3436 of 2020
O R D E R:

This criminal petition is filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C. seeking to quash the proceedings in FIR No.273 of 2020 on the file of the Station House Officer, Kavali Rural Police Station, SPSR Nellore District, against the petitioner for the offence punishable under Sections 272, 273 and 328 IPC and Section 59(i) of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

entities.text: Kavali Rural Police Station, SPSR Nellore District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Public Prosecutor appearing for respondent-State.
Learned counsel for the petitioner has placed reliance on the order dated 21.07.2020 passed in Criminal Petition No.2408 of 2020 by this Court.
In view of the aforesaid, it is urged that the FIR may be quashed against the petitioner.
Learned Public Prosecutor did not oppose the said submission.

Considering the submissions and in view of the fact this matter is squarely covered by the earlier orders, the criminal petition is allowed and proceedings in FIR No.273 of 2020 on the file of the Station House Officer, Kavali Rural Police Station, SPSR Nellore District, against the petitioner, are hereby quashed; consequently, no further action is necessary in the facts of the case.
Miscellaneous applications pending if any, shall stand closed.
_________________ JUSTICE D.RAMESH 27th August, 2020 Mjl/
